events.summary: This update adds three difficulty options, new perks, and an opening story. We’ve also rebalanced the game and reworked Level 2 to make it scarier. events.title: Three heroes, one staircase. Making DEEPWARD's capsule art
events.summary: In DEEPWARD, you don't just switch weapons during a fight. You switch between three characters. So how do you get that across in a single picture, especially one you'll often see as a tiny thumbnail on Steam? That's what we were figuring out with artist James Child while working on our new capsule art. events.title: From Pixel-Inspired Prototype to Fast-Paced Horror FPS: DEEPWARD's Evolution
events.summary: DEEPWARD did not begin with its current atmosphere, detailed environments, or fast-paced combat. It started as a small prototype built to answer one important question: was it fun to fight while pushing deeper and deeper into a cursed mansion? Over the past year and a half, that simple experiment has grown into a horror FPS roguelite set in a cursed mansion hidden in the Carpathian Mountains during the 1920s.
